name: Permanent Battery Storage Rebate
description: $7,500 rebate on permanent battery storage; must have experienced 5+ Wildfire Safety outages since January 1, 2024, be on a time-of-use rate, and enroll in the Emergency Load Reduction Program
fullDescription: PG&E offers a substantial rebate for permanent home battery storage to customers who have experienced frequent Wildfire Safety (EPSS) outages, helping them maintain power reliability.
whatTheyOffer:
- $7,500 rebate for permanent battery storage
- For customers with 5+ Wildfire Safety outages since January 1, 2024
- First-come, first-served with limited rebates remaining
- Battery must be on PG&E's Qualified Product List and bought on or after January 1, 2025
- Must be on a time-of-use rate plan
- Must enroll in the Emergency Load Reduction Program through your battery provider
howToGetIt:
1. Enter your address on PG&E's Wildfire Safety Progress Map and check the "Backup Power Solutions" tab
2. Must be a residential PG&E electric customer getting a battery for the first time
3. Install a qualifying battery and get Permission to Operate
4. Switch to time-of-use rate plan and enroll in the Emergency Load Reduction Program
5. Apply within 12 months of Permission to Operate, and no later than December 31, 2026
keywords: battery storage, rebate, PG&E, EPSS, wildfire safety outage, Tesla Powerwall, outage, backup power, $7500, home battery
